name: facts-format-bump-invalidates-unit-keys
body: FACTS_FORMAT_VERSION also stamps UnitKey.format and ScaffoldingKey.format, so the format-2 bump discards every cached unit and scaffolding body for the repository, not just the refs/scan rows - the same sanctioned one-time full scan, but cross-version unit reuse is deliberately lost. Upgrade to a narrower per-table marker only if unit reuse must survive a refs/scan-row-only generation change.
